title: Holiday Video Maker for Gift Season | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product link into a holiday video that feels festive, with a script, an AI avatar, and a voice. Post the gift ad before the ship-by date is final.
h1: Make a Festive Holiday Video From a Link
lead: Turn a product link into a holiday video that feels festive, with a script, a lifelike AI avatar, and a voice you choose.

faq.q: How do credits work for a holiday photo or video?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A 6-second clip spends 24 credits, 10 seconds spends 40, 15 seconds spends 60, and 30 seconds spends 120. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. You see the cost before the job runs, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I add a holiday song and seasonal pictures?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a track from the music list, add seasonal pictures, and put captions on in the editor. Use a track you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I make a holiday video for each product?
faq.a: Yes. Run several product links, and each one comes back as its own gift scene. You still check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar deliver the holiday message?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar can read a short gift note beside the product. Keep the product easy to recognize.

faq.q: Can I use the holiday file again next season?
faq.a: You keep the file you downloaded. Change the date, the voice, or the offer in the editor, and use the scene again for the next holiday.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Open the product page and use that photo as the gift in the scene. If the page photo is too tight, upload a clear shot you already sell with.

faq.q: Can I publish my holiday video to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file, or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook yourself. You still choose the budget in that ad account.

faq.q: Can my own tools ask for a holiday ad?
faq.a: Yes. Your tools can ask for a holiday ad from a product link. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.
